about_short_description.short_description: We’re Impactive (formerly Outvote), a digital organizing hub for progressive campaigns and causes.

product.name: Peer-to-Peer Texting
product.description: A platform feature enabling volunteers to send personalized one-to-one text messages to supporters at scale for outreach and mobilization.

product.name: Broadcast Texting
product.description: A mass messaging tool that sends opt-in broadcast texts to supporters for fundraising, event reminders, and calls to action.

product.name: Phone Banking with Predictive Dialer
product.description: A phone outreach tool featuring a predictive dialer for efficient patch-through calling and maximizing volunteer call time.

product.name: Relational Organizing and Canvassing
product.description: Tools enabling volunteers to reach personal contacts via multiple channels including text, email, calls, and social media for organizing and outreach.

product.name: Custom Forms
product.description: A feature to create branded forms for event RSVPs, volunteer sign-ups, pledges, and other supporter data collection.

product.name: Social Media Amplification Integration
product.description: An integration that facilitates supporter sharing of pre-generated social media content to expand campaign reach organically.
